title: India’s First Hydrogen Train Starts Journey: 89-km Jind-Sonipat Route, 12 Stations, Zero Emissions: Here’s What You Should Know
description: India launches its first hydrogen-powered train between Jind and Sonipat on July 17, flagged off by PM Modi. With zero emissions, indigenous technology, and a 10-coach configuration, this eco-friendly train marks a new era in green rail transport.
